route.rationale: new cell-add refusal and merge door change public CLI contracts; doctrine, preamble, skills and knowledge

cells.title: Refuse a cell whose verify is the bare full suite
cells.action: Follow the Contract for fso-1 in docs/history/full-suite-once/plan.md: cells add and cells update refuse a verify that runs the bare declared full suite (or bare bee test) with a FIX line naming a scoped form, unless the cell carries a non-empty full_suite_reason. Write the behavior tests first and watch them fail.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test full_suite_verify && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee verbs::cells

truths: cells add refuses a verify that is the bare declared full suite, with a FIX line naming a scoped form
a verify with a test filter after the suite command is accepted
a non-empty full_suite_reason allows the bare suite and stays on the cell
cells update refuses a verify patch to the bare full suite
a repo with no commands.test or the no-test sentinel never refuses

cells.title: Make worktree merge read a fresh green full-suite record
cells.action: Follow the Contract for fso-2 in docs/history/full-suite-once/plan.md: bee test stamps head in its record; bee worktree merge refuses a code-touching feature without a fresh green bee test record from the worktree (MISSING/RED/STALE), accepts --full-suite-waiver with a merge audit row, passes docs-only diffs and no-test repos, and spawns no test. Write the behavior tests first and watch them fail.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test merge_full_suite && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- verbs::test_runner verbs::worktree

truths: bee test writes the checkout HEAD into its record
merge refuses a code-touching feature with no bee test record, naming bee test in the worktree
merge refuses a red record and a record whose head is older than a later code commit
a later docs-only commit keeps the record fresh
--full-suite-waiver merges and writes a merge audit row
a docs-only feature and a no-test repo merge with no record
the merge door runs no test itself

cells.title: Write the once-per-feature suite rule into doctrine, preamble, skills and knowledge
cells.action: Follow the Contract for fso-3 in docs/history/full-suite-once/plan.md: write the owner rule into the agents-proof-at-cap rule of packages/bee/LEADER.md (its one home), replace LEADER.md:324's suite line with a pointer, relabel the preamble and compaction Standard commands test line, fix the verify_owner annotation, fix the skill passages that order a per-cell full run or a re-run of a worker's proof, fix the stale knowledge concept and add the door and the cell check to their area concepts. Run bee dev regen for rendered trees.
cells.verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test rule_index_parity --test instruction_laws --test pointer_integrity --test registry_contracts --test agents_block_render_parity && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --no-fail-fast --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- hooks::session_preamble hooks::compaction verbs::cells && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check && .bee/bin/bee onboard --repo-root . --json

truths: the owner rule has one home in the agents-proof-at-cap rule of packages/bee/LEADER.md
LEADER.md no longer tells an agent to run commands.test before ending work
the preamble test line says the full suite runs once per feature before merge and a cell verify adds a filter
no skill tells an agent to run the full suite per cell or to re-run a worker's proof
the suite-topology concept no longer says doors run the suite or that the full run is daily
